title: xdrip calibration doesn't seem to work
body:
Hi everyone!

A quick question here for those who are using DIY-AAPS. Has anyone used this combination to manager your blood glucose?

freestyle libre (gen 1) + Wangwang*+xdrip + AAPS

I came across a problem when I tried to calibrate. After I calibrated on xdrip, the calibrated BG value did not have any effect on my trend. In another word, the trend is still inaccurate. It seems like I have never calibrated. (see the picture)

Have any of you guys met this problem before? Do you have any solutions? Is there any wrong settings on xdrip?

【*Wangwang is a smart reader for FreeStyle Libre sensors. Continuous glucose readings every 5 minutes straight to your smart phone or smart watch.

Wangwang Freestyle Libre Reader designed to provide continuous glucose reporting automatically every 5 min. to your Smartphone or Smartwatch.

It is like Miaomiao, Blucon.】

comments.body: Bubble was merged in mainstream xDrip+ as per https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/967 you might want to install the supported version and retry.
You mean bubble and xdrip plus are essentially the same? As long as my app is up to date?

I mean the version you're using is most probably outdated but yes, they are now the same. But it doesn't make much sense to open an issue for https://github.com/bubbledevteam/xDrip/tree/bubbledevteam-bubble in this project. Save your settings, export your database, uninstall xDrip Bubble and install https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2019.10.27 recover settings and database, and then if you believe you have a calibration issue update this thread.

Hi，I think you should use the community branch to enable calibration feature, the xdrip_bubble branch may make OOP algorithm which doesn’t support calibration as default.

Try to uninstall the xdrip_bubble,then download the apk file from nightscoutfoundation release page.
